title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site! A multi-page portfolio built with Bootstrap, custom CSS, and JavaScript that loads my projects from a JSON file.
details: Built for MIS 4013. Projects are stored in data/projects.json and loaded with fetch(), so adding a new project only means adding a new object to the JSON file. Includes category filtering, keyword search, a dark mode toggle, and project detail modals.

title: C# Console Applications
description: A set of C# console programs from MIS 4013 practicing variables, loops, conditionals, methods, and user input validation.
details: Each program solves a small business-style problem through the console, like calculating totals, validating input, and looping through menus until the user exits. These assignments are where I got comfortable with object-oriented basics and debugging in Visual Studio.

title: Responsive Bootstrap Web Pages
description: Class web pages using Bootstrap's grid, cards, and navbar to build layouts that adjust from desktop to phone screens.
details: Earlier MIS 4013 assignments focused on the Bootstrap grid system, responsive navbars, and styling components with custom CSS. These were the foundation for this portfolio.

title: Electricity Markets & Renewables Analysis
description: Coursework from EMGT 3113 comparing how solar, wind, and hydro generation fit into electricity markets and pricing.
details: Looked at the fundamentals of different energy types and how electricity markets dispatch generation. Used spreadsheets to compare capacity factors and costs across renewable sources.

title: Renewable Asset Performance Tracker
description: Spreadsheet-based tracker idea from my asset management internship for monitoring how renewable projects perform against expectations.
details: During my summer at Acciona Energy in Chicago I saw how much asset managers rely on tracking actual vs. expected generation. This is a personal version of that idea that I plan to rebuild as a small dashboard. (Placeholder: will update with screenshots once built.)
